messages:
marta (AE): Hey team — kicking off HorizonPay POC thread. They need SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC role mapping, and domain ownership checks. Also asked for a pricing estimate if they need Dedicated vs Hosted for 2M tokens/month.

horizonpay-admin (customer): Thanks Marta. Timeline: POC next Mon -> 2 weeks. Need answers to the security questionnaire by EOD Fri. Can you confirm SCIM delta behavior for multi-org users?

noah (solutions): Short answers first: SCIM supports group and user patching, we support incremental syncs via /Users and /Groups endpoints, and we can do bulk imports. For multi-org accounts we recommend tenant-scoped SCIM tokens; we can scope to domains.

kaleb (SE): To add — for HorizonPay's multi-domain setup, we can map SCIM group membership -> RBAC roles. Example claim mapping: `roles` claim -> Redwood role `team:writer`. We can provide an example SAML assertion if you want.

horizonpay-admin (customer): Yes please, example SAML + example role mapping config. Also: domain verification — can they use DNS TXT or need email?

sophie (security): Domain verification supports DNS TXT and file-based verification. For enterprise customers we prefer DNS TXT for automation. Regarding SAML: we need the IdP metadata; we support SHA256 signatures and both HTTP-Redirect and POST binding.

marta (AE): @sophie can you confirm if we require SCIM over TLS only (answer to questionnaire)?

sophie (security): Yes — SCIM endpoints must be used over TLS1.2+. We also request SCIM audit logs be retained 90 days for Dedicated/Private. For Hosted, we can provide a 30-day export on request.

kaleb (SE): Example SAML snippet for HorizonPay (you can paste into your IdP):
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://api.redwood.com/saml/metadata">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://api.redwood.com/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
Then map `AttributeStatement` > `groups` to `redwood:roles` claim.

horizonpay-admin (customer): Great. For pricing — they asked: hosted rate per 1M tokens vs Dedicated monthly commit for required throughput (10 rps, avg 60 tokens/resp). Any back-of-envelope numbers?

marta (AE): Back of envelope: Hosted: ~ $X per 1M tokens (we'll put exact in a quote). Dedicated: likely a monthly pool; for that throughput we'd recommend a small Dedicated GPU pool — estimate $Y/month + overage. I'll pull exact numbers from pricing doc.

noah (solutions): Also note: if they use prefix caching and batching, token costs can drop ~20-40% depending on prompt reuse. We should offer an Optimize review as part of POC.

horizonpay-admin (customer): Solid. One more: they have a legal SCCs/GDPR checkbox in the questionnaire. Who handles contract additions?

legal-bot: Laura from Legal will handle SCCs and can loop in account team. Please attach the questionnaire PDF to this thread.

marta (AE): I'll attach the questionnaire and schedule a 30-min kickoff with HorizonPay + Kaleb + Sophie tomorrow 10am PT. Action items: Kaleb — prepare SAML + example RBAC mapping doc; Sophie — fill security answers for SCIM/TLS/audit retention; Noah — prepare POC Optimize checklist and rough Dedicated sizing.

kaleb (SE): On it. I'll upload mapping doc before the call.

sophie (security): I'll complete security checklist and drop notes in thread by 5pm PT.

marta (AE): Thanks all :thumbsup:
